column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 / Zero diary

column2: ○ Month, × Day — Rain
A cold rain is falling...
It's been $$５ヶ月$$ today... you still haven't woken up...
Every time I wipe your body, your sharp collarbones stab at my eyes...
The days you spent with me... were you happy, then...?
Can you hear my voice...?
Do my feelings reach you...?
All the countless days we spent together bring freezing rain down again tonight...
△ Month, ○ Day — Rain
The fever that has lasted since last night seems to have finally broken...
The bitter $$薬$$ taste fills my mouth too...
You might hate it if you found out later...
In contrast to your body, so cold that even the hearth couldn't warm it...
the heat in your forehead was like your eyes...
Inside your vacant eyes, there was no one reflected but me...
No... maybe I wasn't reflected there at all...
Honestly...
How long must days like this go on before you wake up...?
◇ Month, ◎ Day — Cloudy
The rain that kept falling for the past $$１ヶ月$$ has finally stopped...
Your condition has finally steadied, and the days have been peaceful.
But even now, you don't see me in your eyes...
There you are, asleep in the dim room, as if you're holding your breath...
For you, this daily life... what meaning could it have...?
You probably couldn't know...
But maybe that makes it easier for me...?!
If you remembered, and spoke to me...
Stupid! What the hell am I thinking ...!?
□ Month, × Day — Sunny
Lately...
you seem to be getting much better...
The first clear day in ages let me hang all the laundry that had piled up. I feel great...!!
You're in a clean shirt today, and sheets that smell of sun... Doesn't that feel good too...?
Summer's almost here.
Hey...
It's about time you woke up, isn't it!?
○ Month, ■ Day — Sunny
Lately,
Your $$回復$$ has come far enough to turn over in your sleep...
and that's why I can't sleep at night...!
I keep thinking you'll wake up while I'm asleep...
Sounds stupid, right!?
It's the same thing every day...
Even so... I'm having a pretty good time, you know...!?
Every time the color comes back to your face...
I think maybe tomorrow I'll finally get to hear your voice...!
